text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove is totally going to win the<n>Osaka Hai!
She's on a whole<n>different level from the other
racers!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I can't wait to be bathed in the<n>light of the
Empress today! Go, Air<n>Groove!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yikes, seems like everyone is an Air<n>Groove fan.
Just focus on yourself,<n>Dober!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober, you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Have you had a good look at the<n>stands? They're
filled with Air<n>Groove's fans. Her popularity is
nothing to sneeze at.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But well, that's just reality. I'm still a<n>long way
from the legacy I'm aiming<n>for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And that's exactly why I'm going to<n>chase after Air
Groove with all I have<n>in this race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have to do everything I can, even if<n>it's only to get
a little closer to my<n>ideal!
choice_data_list: Save some of that energy for the race.
Save some of that energy for the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I know. It's not like I can keep pace<n>with Air
Groove with enthusiasm<n>alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're right. It's not like I can keep<n>pace with Air
Groove with<n>enthusiasm alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove... I look forward to racing<n>you today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm expecting nothing but your best<n>performance,
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I have to keep up with her. I can't let<n>Air Groove
down!)
